units.source_text: 小君虽然是个孩子，却颇能用心窥探，等待良机。

en.t: Although Kokimi was still a child, he was quite careful in spying things out and waited for a good opportunity.

units.source_text: 恰巧纪伊守上任去了，家中只留女眷，清闲度日。

en.t: As it happened, the Governor of Kii had gone to take up his post, leaving only the women of the household at home to pass the days quietly.

units.source_text: 有一天傍晚，天色朦胧，路上行人模糊难辨之时，小君赶了他自己的车子来，请源氏公子上车前往。

en.t: One evening, when the light was dim and people on the road were hard to distinguish, Kokimi brought his own carriage and invited Prince Genji to get in and go with him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心念此人毕竟是个孩子，不知是否可靠。

en.t: Prince Genji thought to himself that the boy was, after all, only a child, and wondered whether he could be trusted.

units.source_text: 然而也不暇仔细考虑，便换上一套微服，趁纪伊守家尚未关门之时急急忙忙前去。

en.t: Yet he had no time to consider the matter carefully, so he changed into plain clothes and hurried off before the gates of the Governor of Kii's house were closed.

units.source_text: 小君只拣人目较少的一个门里驱车进去，请源氏公子下车。

en.t: Kokimi chose a gate where there were fewer eyes, drove the carriage in, and asked Prince Genji to get down.

units.source_text: 值宿人等看见驾车的是个小孩，谁也不介意，也就没有来迎候，倒反而安乐。

en.t: The night attendants saw that the driver was only a child, so no one paid any attention or came out to receive him, which made things easier instead.

units.source_text: 小君请源氏公子站在东面的边门口等候，自己却把南面角上的一个房间的格子门砰的一声打开，走进室内去。

en.t: Kokimi asked Prince Genji to wait standing at the eastern side entrance, while he himself flung open the lattice door of a room at the southern corner with a bang and went inside.

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“这样，外面望进来看得见了！”

en.t: The serving women said, "If you do that, people looking in from outside will be able to see us!"

units.source_text: 小君说：“这么热的天，为什么把格子门关上？”

en.t: Kokimi said, "On such a hot day, why keep the lattice door shut?"

units.source_text: 侍女回答道：“西厢小姐[\[2\]](#part1332.html#m2)从白天就来这里，正在下棋呢。”

en.t: A serving woman answered, "The young lady from the western wing[\[2\]](#part1332.html#m2) has been here since daytime and is playing go now."

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“我倒想看看她们面对面下棋呢。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "I would like to see them facing each other over a game of go."

units.source_text: 便悄悄地从边门口走到这边来，钻进帘子和格子门之间的狭缝里。

en.t: So he quietly came over from the side entrance and slipped into the narrow gap between the blind and the lattice door.

units.source_text: 小君打开的那扇格子门还没有关上，有缝隙可以窥探。

en.t: The lattice door that Kokimi had opened had not yet been closed, leaving a gap through which one could peer inside.

units.source_text: 朝西一望，设在格子门旁边的屏风的一端正好折叠着。

en.t: Looking toward the west, he saw that one end of the screen set beside the lattice door happened to be folded back.

units.source_text: 因为天热，遮阳的帷屏的垂布也都挂起，源氏公子可以分明望见室内的光景。

en.t: Because of the heat, the hanging cloths of the sunshade screens had all been lifted too, so Prince Genji could see the scene inside the room clearly.
